prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 30 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1242; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of neck pain and stiffness. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms, and the presentation is plausible for a crash of this type. Initial examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion and tenderness over the paraspinal muscles, while neurological screening and imaging findings were within normal limits. The patient has a remote history of a minor cervical strain that resolved completely without lasting residual symptoms. Over the course of care, the patient completed 30 visits, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for a cervical strain of this severity. Treatment included manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching program instruction. Billing records reflect single entries for each service without duplicate or repeated charges. At the time of this summary, the patient continues to report intermittent neck discomfort with activity, and a gradual return to normal function is anticipated.
